value.rationale: A natural fully global phase-sensitive single-kernel approximation benchmark: the sharp α=0 qualitative boundary, exact critical parameter, pinned off-axis radius, square-root angular coalescence and one-sided radial derivative give a structural parameter-selection law. It is not a numerical or arbitrary coefficient slice: the target is the lowest-degree real polynomial displaying incompatible constant and quadratic phases with a linear control.
